# E30 build plan

Status: proposed for senior review. No product code or implementation gate has run. The frozen design remains unchanged.

## Build order and boundaries

The repository currently has no `hub/`, `ui/`, `eval/`, `workers/camera/`, generated hub contracts or non-pharmacy runtime configuration. `docs/tdd/E06.md` and `docs/requests/E30.md` are absent. Package schemas/examples exist under `docs/product/api/`; they are specifications, never production fallback data. Python gates use the future standalone hub project, not the existing pharmacy project (docs/SYSTEM.md:1661).

| Task | Sole write ownership | Connection and ordering |
|---|---|---|
| T1 | `config/skills-catalog.json`, `hub/src/crew_health/teach/`, `hub/tests/teach/` | One owner builds the hub workflow, domain, repositories, checks, gateways, API and registration. Avoids competing edits to transactions, attempt history and drill isolation. |
| T2 | `workers/camera/src/crew_camera/analyzers/compression_rate/`, `workers/camera/tests/compression_rate/` | Reserved by E30 section 13 subject to X8. Dispatch is blocked on P30-3: E06 must settle the host namespace and authorize the carveout. Never create a second worker package. |
| T3 | `ui/crew/src/features/teach/` | Builds against approved generated models and E03 shell interfaces. Owns its component and Playwright tests. No writes to embedding screens or offline infrastructure. |
| T4 | `eval/studies/teach_and_check/` | Freezes protocol, validates approved consent/data and implements reproducible analysis. Software work can proceed independently; collection/publication requires real consent and evidence. |
| T5 | `eval/scenarios/teach_and_check/` | Depends on T1 to T4 for complete acceptance. Owns real HTTP scenario assertions and consumes T3 browser evidence. No writes to E21 runner, fixture, registry or result panel. |

T1, T3 and T4 begin independent work after the senior review and the interfaces needed by that work arrive. T2 begins immediately after its ownership/host dependency is settled. T5 can write source-derived assertions early, but executes complete acceptance only after its providers land. Tasks do not wait for another epic's final greenlight to consume an implemented, reviewed port. SYSTEM section 9 makes E01/E02/E05/E27-guidance hard dependencies; E06/E07/E22/E28/E31 are optional capabilities (docs/SYSTEM.md:2375). E26/E23 are needed only for their contextual paths. Fixed help and E01 manual entry remain independent.

All write roots are copied from E30 section 13 (docs/tdd/E30.md:1150). Existing other-epic tasks were parsed for ownership; none owns these roots. Relevant neighboring boundaries are E01 core/generated artifacts, E02 identity/consent, E03 copy/shell, E05 measurement, E20 offline/deployment, E21 runner/fixture/results, E28 plans and E31 roles. Recheck all `docs/build/*/tasks.json` before dispatch because other planners are working concurrently. SYSTEM's worker-wide E06 ownership is the explicit unresolved T2 exception, not an assumed grant.

## Connections

T1 registers through `ModuleRegistry`, checks through `ReleaseCheck`, settings through `SettingSpec`, and import restrictions through module-local architecture configuration (SYSTEM 5.6, 5.11, 5.12, 6.4). Shared errors, clocks, identifiers, UCUM quantities, transactions, command identities, audit, scheduled work and worker tasks come exclusively from SYSTEM section 5. No shared-file patch is necessary or authorized.

HTTP boundary models come from E01's guarded effective contracts. T1 pins `ReleaseHandle`, validates eligibility through E27 and appends records through E01's settled records ports. Accepted finish publishes `GuidedCheckCompleted` in its transaction; E28 and E31 own their handlers. Camera acquisition/coaching use E06's published boundary, with frames remaining on the capture node. T3 renders approved hub text and uses E03/E20 infrastructure; it never queues taps or caches clinical results. T4 receives only consented, source-linked study data. T5 exercises these connections through the composition root, not replacement hub services.

A provider protocol still awaiting agreement is not a license to copy its proposed shape. Use SYSTEM section 10 kernel fakes for isolated development after E01 delivers them. Production and end to end integration stay blocked until the relevant request is settled.

## End to end evidence

Every row runs through real hub HTTP/composition with temporary real SQLite or Playwright against that hub. No mocks inside the hub. Optional external workers may use their documented adapters/fakes in explicitly SIM software runs; model, devices and ground otherwise remain absent. T5 asserts that every required scenario actually collects. Unit tests and a nonempty broad marker expression cannot substitute for a missing scenario.

| Evidence | What it proves |
|---|---|
| V85, D38; T30-02/08/13/23/26 | Complete taught count, independently checked 92 versus 96 vector, source/operator/time/pin, Answer at answer, one manual Observation and eligible E28 completion. Actual Teach Tomas UI leaves the capability ring dashed. D38 additionally requires separately identified LIVE presenter acquisition/routing; SIM software success cannot earn that clause. |
| V86; T30-03/19/33/35 | Disagreement preserves manual and available camera observations without blame, retry and Answer supersession retain history, no plan completion or successful practice, no gap/diagnosis upgrade. Independent sources compared separately; old-attempt packets rejected. |
| V87; T30-04/05/11 | Camera absent/refusing/hung with model/devices/ground absent still records a complete manual count as unchecked with reason. Actual assessment support verification cannot cite the unchecked value as support. |
| V96; T30-20/21/22/25/31/36 | Below-band then hidden-hands external SIM input traverses coaching and renders configured text, then no number. Fixed help is unchanged and static. Actual unvalidated analyzer separately refuses all numeric output. Expiry, future/late/replayed input, SSE loss, hub death, arbitration and restart cannot leave stale advice current. |
| T30-07/16/17/18/29/34 | Kill before/after command write/commit/ACK boundaries, disk full and other storage faults, concurrent clients, lost replies and late replay preserve accepted records exactly once. Interrupted count never yields a rate. Clock jumps/segments/suspension and load cannot fabricate current measurements or delay fixed help beyond its required budget. |
| T30-10/15/21/32 | Drill numbers reach no persistent sink, including WAL, ledger, audit, outbox and worker store. Valid foreign IDs, revoked grants, station/officer overreach, owner switch and incapacitation follow current object/field rules. Permitted narrow access is tested alongside denials. |
| V98; T30-12/24/27/38 | Real scratch configuration activation changes label/phrase/step without a rebuild, retains open-work pins and active warnings, rejects corrupt updates and handles missing versions loudly. All five teaching paths include provenance/notice, landmark, bleeding question and eye timer. |

T1 owns hub-level T30-01 through T30-23, T30-27/28/29 and T30-32 through T30-38. T2 owns worker T30-31 and worker counterparts. T3 owns T30-24/25/26 and browser T30-34/36/38. T4 owns T30-30. T5 upgrades the critical paths and every E30 V/D scenario to composed-stack evidence. Shared IDs identify counterpart levels, not duplicate implementations. Traces include R51/R52, contributing R50/R55, V85/V86/V87/V96/V98, D38, EI8/EI10 and I30-01 through I30-19 (docs/tdd/E30.md:386,1063). V97's shared cache mechanism belongs to E20/E26/E28; E30 supplies its teaching fallback evidence.

## Gates and hand-in

Exact commands are in `tasks.json`. They intentionally fail while required projects, providers or requests are missing. Python uses `uv run --project hub` or the camera member; JavaScript uses pnpm. Generated import contracts are checked after generation. T1 records branch-enabled coverage; the shared gate must check each teach domain/application file, not an aggregate that hides an unmeasured file. T2 also requires genuine worker import coverage. T3 runs real-browser tests in its owned feature. T4 exercises the analysis CLI on explicit temporary SIM files. T5 runs unfiltered E30 scenarios, verifies scenario collection, then the full hub/UI suites. End to end fault cases use published provider fault seams, never hub mocks.

No implementation gate was run by this planner. Local success, resolved independent review, CI success and honest LIVE/reference/venue evidence are separate requirements. Pending ownership, shared mechanisms or positive scenario evidence withhold epic completion. Numerical verification and model validation remain separate from clinical validation and mission acceptance.
